moments.title: UK Summer Bank Holiday Approaches
moments.blurb: England, Wales, and Northern Ireland will observe the Summer Bank Holiday on Monday, August 31, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Who's ready for a long weekend? The Summer Bank Holiday is just days away – what are your plans for that extra day off?

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: Make the most of the last bank holiday of summer! Sunshine or showers, we're here to soundtrack your long weekend.

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's leading electronic dance music festivals, takes place from August 27-30 in Daresbury, featuring acts like Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and Tiësto.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 starts tomorrow! Who's heading to Daresbury for a weekend of the biggest dance anthems and world-class DJs? #Creamfields

angles.name: DJ Lineup Hype
angles.copy: From Calvin Harris to Swedish House Mafia, Creamfields is stacked! Which set are you most buzzing for this weekend?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Begin
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals run from August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Kick-off
angles.copy: It's almost time! Reading & Leeds Festivals ignite tomorrow. Who are you catching on the main stages this Bank Holiday weekend?

angles.name: Diverse Lineup
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Fontaines D.C. and Dave, Reading & Leeds has something for everyone. What's your must-see act?

moments.title: All Points East Concludes This Weekend
moments.blurb: The All Points East festival in London's Victoria Park wraps up this weekend, with performances from artists like Lorde, Tyler, The Creator, and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: London Festival Finale
angles.copy: All Points East is bringing the heat to Victoria Park for its final days this weekend! Who's heading down for the London festival vibes?

angles.name: Last Chance for APE
angles.copy: Don't miss your last chance to catch Lorde, Tyler, The Creator, and more at All Points East this weekend. What a lineup!

moments.title: Premier League Continues with Matchweek 2 & 3
moments.blurb: The Premier League season is in full swing with Matchweek 2 fixtures on Friday, August 28, and more games through the weekend, leading into Matchweek 3 starting September 4.

angles.name: Football Weekend Kicks Off
angles.copy: Premier League action is back this weekend! Which fixture are you most looking forward to, and who needs those crucial early points?

angles.name: Weekend Predictions
angles.copy: Matchweek 2 & 3 fixtures are upon us. Share your predictions for the weekend's biggest games!

moments.title: US Open Tennis Main Draw Begins
moments.blurb: The main draw for the final Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, officially begins on Monday, August 30, in New York.

angles.name: Grand Slam Action
angles.copy: It's almost time for the US Open main draw! Who are your picks to lift the trophies in New York this year?

angles.name: Tennis Fever
angles.copy: The biggest names in tennis descend on Flushing Meadows as the US Open main draw kicks off Monday. Get ready for two weeks of incredible action!

moments.title: Ariana Grande Continues London Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour' continues its highly anticipated London residency at the O2 Arena with upcoming dates on August 27, 31, and September 1.

angles.name: Ariana Live in London
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' tour is still lighting up London's O2 this week! Who's managed to grab tickets?

angles.name: Pop Phenomenon
angles.copy: Another chance to catch Ariana Grande live in London this week! Get ready for those powerhouse vocals and incredible stage presence.

moments.title: Bon Jovi's UK 'Forever Tour' Underway
moments.blurb: Rock legends Bon Jovi bring their 'Forever Tour' to the UK, with a show in Edinburgh on August 28 and multiple London dates in early September.

angles.name: Rock Icons Live
angles.copy: Bon Jovi's 'Forever Tour' hits Edinburgh tomorrow and London next week! Get ready to sing along to all the classics. #BonJovi

angles.name: Edinburgh Rock
angles.copy: If you're in Edinburgh, Bon Jovi are bringing the house down tomorrow! A rare chance to see rock royalty.

moments.title: Jay-Z Bringing 'AURA World Tour' to London
moments.blurb: Hip-hop icon Jay-Z is set to play two huge shows in London on September 4-5 as part of his 'AURA World Tour'.

angles.name: Hova in London
angles.copy: Jay-Z is bringing his 'AURA World Tour' to London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium next week! Who's ready for a dose of hip-hop royalty?

angles.name: London Hip-Hop
angles.copy: Two nights of Jay-Z in London next week! Get ready for an unforgettable show.

moments.title: Valerie Simpson turns 80
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Valerie Simpson, half of the iconic Motown duo Ashford & Simpson, celebrates her 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Motown Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the incredible Valerie Simpson! Her contributions to soul and Motown as half of Ashford & Simpson are legendary. What's your favourite song she wrote?

angles.name: Celebrating a Songwriter
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Valerie Simpson, 80 today! Her timeless songwriting with Nick Ashford shaped so many classic hits. Tune in for some of her best!

moments.title: Shirley Manson turns 60
moments.blurb: Scottish singer Shirley Manson, lead vocalist of the alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the iconic Shirley Manson of Garbage! A true rock legend with an unmistakable voice. What's your favourite Garbage track?

angles.name: Alternative Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Shirley Manson's 60th today! The Scottish powerhouse fronted Garbage through some of the 90s' biggest alternative hits. Pure class.

moments.title: Keke Palmer turns 33
moments.blurb: American actress, singer, and television personality Keke Palmer, known for her dynamic presence across entertainment, celebrates her 33rd birthday today.

angles.name: Multi-talented Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the incredibly talented Keke Palmer! Singer, actress, TV host – she does it all! Celebrate with her best tracks.

angles.name: Celebrating Keke
angles.copy: It's Keke Palmer's 33rd birthday! From music to movies, she's a force to be reckoned with. What's your favourite Keke moment?

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison, famous for hits like 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', celebrates his 81st birthday on August 31.

angles.name: Legend's Milestone Birthday
angles.copy: Next Monday, a true music legend turns 81! Happy early birthday to the one and only Van Morrison. What's your favourite 'Van the Man' track?

angles.name: Celebrating an Icon
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Van Morrison's 81st on Monday! His incredible career spans decades of rock, blues, and soul. Timeless tunes all day!

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, known as Queen Bey and for her work with Destiny's Child, will celebrate her 45th birthday on September 4.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The one and only Beyoncé turns 45 next Wednesday. Get ready for a week of celebrating Queen Bey!

angles.name: Celebrating a Global Icon
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to solo superstardom, Beyoncé is a force of nature. We're counting down to her 45th birthday next week!

moments.title: Barry Gibb turns 80
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the legendary singer, songwriter, and producer from the Bee Gees, will celebrate his 80th birthday on September 1.

angles.name: Bee Gees Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Next Tuesday, a true music icon turns 80! Happy early birthday to Sir Barry Gibb of the Bee Gees. His impact on music is immeasurable.

angles.name: Celebrating a Songwriting Genius

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop superstar Gloria Estefan, known for her work with Miami Sound Machine and her solo career, celebrates her 69th birthday on September 1.
